description: This Java source file defines a custom layout manager class 'CustomLayout' extending ViewGroup. It includes measurement and layout logic for positioning child views, along with custom layout parameters and attributes.

classes.name: CustomLayout
classes.description: A custom layout manager that arranges child views with configurable left, right, or middle positioning, handling measurement and positioning based on layout parameters.

methods.name: CustomLayout
methods.description: Constructors for CustomLayout, initializing via context and attribute sets.

methods.name: shouldDelayChildPressedState
methods.description: Returns whether child pressed states should be delayed; here it always returns false.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Measures children and computes the overall dimensions based on children's sizes and layout parameters.

methods.name: onLayout
methods.description: Positions child views within the layout based on custom layout parameters and measured sizes.
